name: Hanshow Technology Co Ltd
summary: Hanshow Technology Co. Ltd specializes in providing advanced electronic shelf labeling (ESL) solutions. Beyond ESL, the company develops AI-powered monitoring systems, including Visight cameras and Spatrol robots, designed to oversee shelf conditions and track customer traffic. Additionally, Hanshow offers intelligent shopping trolleys, which feature integrated screens and basket base scales to facilitate self-checkout capabilities for shoppers. The firm also manages its comprehensive suite of IoT devices through its proprietary All-Star Platform. Established in 2011, Hanshow Technology is headquartered in Jiaxing, China.
